# external.vastimpression__v1

## Purpose
Raw, GCS-archived firehose of **served CTV / VAST video impressions** — a BigQuery **external federated PARQUET** table over `gs://mntn-data-archive-prod/vastimpression/`, hive-partitioned `dt` (date) → `hh` (hour). It is the **CTV/VAST half of the impression feed**: silver `impression_log` = `external.impression__v1` (display) **UNION** `external.vastimpression__v1` (this table). `impression_log` is in turn the **linking source for the Cost Impression Log** (`summarydata.cost_impression_log` / CIL): a `spend_log`/`win_log` impression is flagged `unlinked=false` (billable, enriched) when its impression id is found in `impression_log`. Reach for this table when you need **raw per-impression VAST detail** (IP at CTV playback, `app_bundle`, `ttd_impression_id`, exchange) not carried in the deduped silver tables, or to trace impressions that failed to link into CIL. Note: `silver.logdata.event_log` (`event_type_raw='vast_impression'`) is the **SQLMesh-modeled, deduped view** of the same VAST-playback event — prefer it for routine work; this external table is the underlying archive.

## Grain & keys
- **Grain:** one row per **served CTV/VAST video impression**. `ad_served_id` is **unique per row** — 7,555,975 rows = 7,555,975 distinct `ad_served_id` in one sampled hour (strictly 1:1, no dedup needed within a partition).
- **Key(s) / join columns:** `ad_served_id` (UUID string — the impression key; joins to `event_log.ad_served_id`, `ui_visits.ad_served_id`, `cost_impression_log`). `guid` (identity/household GUID — many impressions per guid). `ip` / `bid_ip` (device IP). `advertiser_id` / `campaign_id` / `creative_id` (serving IDs). `ttd_impression_id` (The Trade Desk impression id, ~all rows).

## Column meanings (only the non-obvious ones)
- **`epoch`** — impression timestamp in **MICROSECONDS** since Unix epoch. Verified `epoch = UNIX_MICROS(time)` exactly (e.g. `1784379412128000` ↔ `2026-07-18 12:56:52`). Not ms, not ns.
- **`time`** — impression `TIMESTAMP` (UTC); the hour matches the `hh` partition.
- **`ip`** — **device IP at VAST playback** (CTV device IP). Always populated (0 nulls in sample). Equals `bid_ip` in **~95%** of rows; ~5% differ (IP mutation between bid and playback — same phenomenon documented for `event_log.ip` vs `bid_ip`). Bare IP on current data — **no `/32`–`/128` CIDR suffix** (unlike `event_log.ip` pre-2026).
- **`bid_ip`** — IP from the winning bid (see `ip`).
- **`guid`** — identity/household GUID (deterministic). Fans out heavily: ~1.68M distinct `guid` across 7.56M impressions in one hour (~4.5 impressions/guid).
- **`original_aid` / `original_cid` / `original_ip`** — the **pre-remap** advertiser / campaign / IP. Non-null for all rows and equal to `advertiser_id` / `campaign_id` / `ip` in **>99.99%** of rows (only 337 of 7.56M differ for aid & cid; `original_ip = ip` in 100% of sample). Use when you need the identifier **as originally logged**, before any account/campaign remap.
- **`cpm`, `cpi`** — **entirely NULL** for VAST impressions (0 populated in sample). Do **not** source impression price/spend here — that lives in `spend_log` / `win_logs` / CIL.
- **`is_baseline`, `cache_buster`, `exchange_io`** — effectively unused for VAST (`is_baseline` all false, `exchange_io` 0 populated in sample).
- **`exchange_id`** — SSP/exchange id; very low cardinality (6 distinct in sample).
- **`app_bundle`** — CTV app identifier; populated for ~all rows (CTV app inventory). **`domain` / `subdomain`** — publisher domain; `domain` ~72% populated (null on ~28% of app inventory).
- **`deal_id`** — PMP/deal id; ~all rows populated.
- **`ttd_impression_id`** — The Trade Desk impression id; ~all rows populated (this inventory is largely TTD-sourced).
- **`user_agent`** — parsed-UA `STRUCT<is_mobile_device, browser, operating_system, device_type, browser_version>`; `browser` is also mirrored as a top-level string column.
- **`dt`, `hh`** — hive **partition** columns. `dt` is `DATE`; **`hh` is a STRING** (`'00'`–`'23'`) — filter `hh='12'`, not `hh=12`.
- **`_source_file` / `_batch_id`** — ingestion provenance (source parquet object + batch); `NOT NULL`.

## Joins & relationships
- **→ `silver.logdata.event_log`** on `ad_served_id` — `event_log` (`event_type_raw='vast_impression'`) is the SQLMesh-modeled, **deduped** view of the same event. `event_log` holds multiple event_types per `ad_served_id` (vast_start/firstQuartile/… dedup with `ROW_NUMBER() … rn=1`); **this table is already 1 row per `ad_served_id`**, so the effective relationship is **1:1** on the vast_impression event.
- **→ `silver.summarydata.cost_impression_log` (CIL)** — `impression_log` (= `impression__v1` UNION this table) is CIL's **linking source**. `unlinked=false` ⇔ the impression id was found in `impression_log`. **`impression_log` lookback = 3 hours** — VAST rows arriving later don't link on the normal incremental run (require a restate).
- **→ `ui_visits` / `clickpass`** on `ad_served_id` — trace an impression to its downstream visit; use a **30-day lookback** (a VV can lag its impression by up to 30 days).
- **Sibling:** `external.impression__v1` (display) has the **identical schema**; `impression__v1 UNION vastimpression__v1` = the full impression feed behind `impression_log`.
- **Fan-out:** self-grain is 1 row per `ad_served_id` (no self fan-out). Joining on **`guid` or `ip` fans out massively** (~1.68M distinct guid/ip per 7.56M rows/hour → thousands of impressions per IP over days) — never join on `guid`/`ip` without a **date-bounded, deduped** subquery.

## Gotchas
- **External federated PARQUET over GCS — no BQ storage metadata.** `bq show` reports `numRows=0`, `numBytes=0`, no partition/cluster stats. Expected, not an error.
- **`--dry_run` cannot estimate cost** — it returns *"lower bound of 0 bytes"* for this table. You **cannot** pre-check bytes; budget from the partition object size instead (~20.7 GiB/day, see Cost).
- **Always filter `dt`** (and `hh` when possible). No `requirePartitionFilter` is enforced, but an unfiltered query scans **every parquet object across the entire archive**.
- **`dt=__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__`** — rows whose `dt` couldn't be parsed land in `gs://…/vastimpression/dt=__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__/`. A `WHERE dt BETWEEN …` range **silently excludes** them.
- **Rolling archive, not permanent.** Earliest partition present = `dt=2025-08-25`, latest = `dt=2026-07-20` (330 daily partitions as of 2026-07-20) → **~11-month rolling retention** governed by the GCS bucket lifecycle, **not a BQ TTL**. Older dates (e.g. `2025-01-15`) return **zero rows**.
- **`cpm`/`cpi` are always NULL here** — get impression price from `spend_log`/CIL.
- **`ip` is a bare IP** on current data (no `/32` suffix); the CIDR-suffix quirk documented for `event_log.ip` on pre-2026 data does not appear on these partitions.
- **`hh` is a STRING**, not an INT.

## Cost & partitioning notes
- **Hive-partitioned `dt` (DATE) → `hh` (STRING hour); no cluster.** Always filter `dt`; add `hh` to scan a single hour.
- **Real backing storage (GCS parquet, all columns): ~20.7 GiB per day** — `gsutil du` on `dt=2026-07-18` = 20.74 GiB. `SELECT *` over one `dt` scans ~this much; an unfiltered scan reads all **330** partitions.
- **Column pruning applies** (PARQUET is columnar) — selecting a few columns scans far less than `SELECT *`; combine with a `dt` (and `hh`) filter.
- **`--dry_run` byte estimate is unavailable** for external tables (reports 0 bytes). The 20.7 GiB/day figure is the **actual GCS object size for the full column set** (not a dry-run estimate); narrower column sets scan proportionally less.
- Volume reference: **~7.56M rows in one peak hour** (`dt=2026-07-18 hh=12`) — this is a high-volume firehose.
- Job **location `us-central1`** (external table lives there); covered by the org slot reservation.

## Example queries
```sql
-- One hour of VAST impressions with the IP-at-playback (always filter dt, ideally hh)
SELECT ad_served_id, guid, ip, bid_ip, campaign_id, advertiser_id, creative_id, time
FROM `dw-main-bronze.external.vastimpression__v1`
WHERE dt = '2026-07-18' AND hh = '12'
LIMIT 100;

-- epoch is MICROSECONDS: epoch = UNIX_MICROS(time)
SELECT ad_served_id, epoch, TIMESTAMP_MICROS(epoch) AS ts
FROM `dw-main-bronze.external.vastimpression__v1`
WHERE dt = '2026-07-18' AND hh = '00'
LIMIT 10;
```
